en.description:
Four tools: write a card, look one up, change its state, schedule. Corrections never overwrite - the old card is superseded. Every turn it pushes two relevant old memories to the front, so the model never has to search; lookup comes in two tiers, exact and maybe-related. A cold tier carries off ledgers untouched for three months - nothing is deleted, and they can be warmed back. A 3D star map shows the whole store at a glance. About 1,000 tokens resident, fully local, MIT.

QQ group: 745879632
